name: Reown
description: External wallet connection infrastructure enabling dApps to connect to user-owned wallets (MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, etc.) via a standardized protocol. Complement to embedded wallet tools — use when users already have a wallet.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The default external wallet connection standard for Ethereum dApps.
Solana support exists via adapters but not the primary choice in Solana ecosystem.
Less relevant in Farcaster miniapp context where Privy embedded wallet is dominant.

common_pairings.context: Reown AppKit is built on top of wagmi for Ethereum wallet interactions.
viem as the underlying Ethereum interaction library in the Reown + wagmi stack.

trust_evidence.description: WalletConnect protocol (now Reown) is the long-standing standard for external wallet connection in Ethereum ecosystem.
Rebranded from WalletConnect to Reown with active AppKit development.

sdk_migration.notes: WalletConnect rebranded to Reown in 2024. @walletconnect/* packages remain functional but @reown/* is the current recommended path. Repo detection of @walletconnect/* should map to this record.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When the goal is onboarding users WITHOUT existing wallets. Privy creates embedded wallets; Reown connects existing wallets.
When unified support for both embedded wallet creation AND external wallet connection is needed in a single SDK.

anti_patterns: Using Reown for embedded wallet creation — it is an external wallet connection protocol, not a wallet provider.
Using Reown in contexts where users are non-crypto-native (no existing wallet). Use Privy or Dynamic instead.
Referencing @walletconnect/* in new projects — use @reown/appkit instead.
